rows.grounds: compound evam+ādau; locative sense 'in the beginning'

items.question: How should a temple be arranged after examining the prescribed divisions?
items.inference: Therefore one should arrange the temple only after examining the prescribed divisions.
uncertainties: The exact scope of evamādau remains context-dependent.
Whether parīkṣya refers to all preceding divisions or only the immediately preceding ones is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Having examined such matters from the beginning, one should indeed arrange the temple.
